posts.title: Designing Power BI with Claude as the build partner
posts.excerpt: PowerBI-Claude-Design is a library of Claude.ai skill packages for authoring Power BI semantic models and reports — TMDL, DAX, calculation groups, UDFs, plus a visual design system. The folder is the source of truth.

posts.title: A Power BI icon picker, powered by Iconify
posts.excerpt: A notebook + .pbix that turns Power BI icon-hunting into one step: search 60,000+ Iconify icons, pick colour and variant, get a DAX-ready measure string in one click.

posts.title: A small tool for documenting Power BI models
posts.excerpt: PowerBI-Lineage is a tool I wrote to document a Power BI model end-to-end — tables, relationships, measures, and how they all hang together — without having to write it yourself.
